Kling Image 4.0 ranks #7 in Text to Image and #6 in Image Editing, behind only OpenAI and Microsoft AI models

It generates images up to 8K, and its 2K price is under a third of the price of every OpenAI model ranked above it. In Image Editing, it sits just behind GPT Image 2.5 Flare (max) at #5 and ranks in the top 5 for 5 of 7 editing actions.

It is also a big step up from Kling Image 3.0 Omni, which ranked #86 in Text to Image and #67 in Image Editing before this launch. Kling Image 4.0 gains more than 225 Elo on both boards and improves on Kling Image 3.0 Omni in every editing action and Text to Image capability.
